svg.title: Arteries advanced tech and production tree
svg.desc: A proposed five-branch technology DAG where each discovery requires research, prerequisite technologies, and a specific combination of goods present in a settlement. Routing goods together is how the player guides technological progress.
svg.text: The player guides discovery by routing goods into the same settlement.
for at least one market day
GATE goods that must meet in one place
EFFECT recipe, mode, or production boost
No tech unlocks from research alone.
Arteries prototype · proposed advanced tree · routing choices assemble the research environment
